episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Han Joon Hee continues to grieve Goo Yun Joon. When she receives mysterious flowers on her birthday, she has an odd feeling that her late lover may be nearby.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: While investigating her lookalike, Joon Hee receives a strange package. Kwon Min Joo develops a friendship with her crush but soon faces a huge letdown.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Joon Hee tries to make sense of Min Joo's recollections that get jumbled up with her own. Nam Si Hoon discovers a new side to Min Joo.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: As Joon Hee struggles to distinguish reality from her dreams, she receives an old diary that contains a shocking truth.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Back in 1998, Joon Hee's bubbly personality shines through Min Joo. Those around her begin to notice — including a mysterious figure who watches from afar.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Si Hun finds himself attracted to the new Min Joo. The love triangle grows when he decides to come clean to Jung In gyu.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Joon Hee tries to warn the boys of the approaching danger. Meanwhile, a horrifying event takes place at school during the night.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Yun Joon eventually finds his way to Joon Hee. He does whatever he can to enchant her, but falling in love is not as easy as it seems.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Joon Hee and Yun Joon enjoy a stretch of happiness. Meanwhile, Si Hun deals with one obstacle after another.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Joon Hee vows to change the past and save Min Joo. Si Hoonn, while investigating the murder, stumbles upon a chilling truth.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Min Joo turns a blind eye to the dangers ahead and focuses on spending time with Si Hun. Si Hun and In Gyu, however, start to grow suspicious.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: As Min Joo takes her life into her own hands, Joon Hee makes a last-ditch effort. She and Si Hun later decide to finally make things right.
